verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Adyen provides the banking-license/BIN-sponsorship layer, Visa/Mastercard card issuing, and program-management tooling (transaction rules, disputes, webhooks, card lifecycle) so a founder need not become a bank (adyen-issuing-docs-38, adyen-issuing-docs-1, adyen-issuing-docs-23, adyen-issuing-docs-25). However, there is no documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline or onboarding SLA anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: a concrete documented time-from-signup-to-first-live-card metric, explicit description of network membership process, and any third-party corroboration of launch speed.
